authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login real-data source window. Planning Data reports 990 local-plan records from 84 data providers; local-plan records can expose plan process, period, organisation and exact local-plan-boundary/local-planning-authority identifiers, making this dataset relevant to future-growth evidence. A bounded window of at most 50 candidates was considered. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA/local-plan-boundary reference, local-authority code, local-plan reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, title identifier, or equivalent selector binding any candidate local plan or its boundary Polygon/MultiPolygon to this slot. Selecting one would invent partition ownership. Therefore no coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
